title: Add Two Polynomials Represented as Linked Lists
description: Add two polynomials represented by linked lists where each node contains a coefficient and exponent.
pseudocode:
1: function addPoly(l1, l2):
2:   dummy = new Node()
3:   curr = dummy
4:   while l1 or l2:
5:     if l1.exp == l2.exp: sum = l1.coeff + l2.coeff; l1=l1.next; l2=l2.next
6:     else if l1.exp > l2.exp: sum = l1.coeff; l1=l1.next
7:     else: sum = l2.coeff; l2=l2.next
8:     curr.next = new Node(sum)
9:     curr = curr.next

steps.note: Initialize dummy node to track the head of the result list.
Compare exponents of current nodes (2x^2 + 1x^0) and (3x^2 + 4x^1).
Append result node 5x^2 to the list.
Append result node 4x^1 to the list.
